import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Regions are Northeast, Midwest, South, West (rows 93 to 96, index 92 to 95)
# 2019 column is 55
regions = df.iloc[92:96, [0, 55]].copy()
regions.columns = ['Region', 'Rate']
regions['Rate'] = pd.to_numeric(regions['Rate'])
result = regions.loc[regions['Rate'].idxmax(), 'Region'].strip()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Subgroups under Hispanic or Latino: Mexican (row 46), Puerto Rican (row 47), Cuban (row 48), Other Hispanic or Latino (row 49)
# Column 0 is characteristic, column 55 is 2019
subgroups = df.iloc[45:49, [0, 55]].copy()
subgroups.columns = ['Subgroup', 'Rate']
subgroups['Rate'] = pd.to_numeric(subgroups['Rate'])
top2 = subgroups.sort_values(by='Rate', ascending=False).head(2)
result = [name.strip() for name in top2['Subgroup'].tolist()]

import pandas as pd
import re

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_uninsured.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Headers in row index 3
headers = df.iloc[3].tolist()
col_2010 = [i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if isinstance(h, str) and re.match(r'^2010', h)][0]
col_2019 = [i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if isinstance(h, str) and re.match(r'^2019', h)][0]
# Row 13 (index 12) is Under 18 years
rate_2010 = float(df.iloc[12, col_2010])
rate_2019 = float(df.iloc[12, col_2019])
result = 'yes' if rate_2019 < rate_2010 else 'no'
